description: Matrix D5: merge compares tool names exactly. allowedTools ["Query"] intersected with ["query"] is [] (allowedTools is case-sensitive, so these are different tools). hiddenTools ["A"] unioned with ["a"] keeps both spellings, in first-seen order -- the union is exact, and the ASCII case fold happens later, at matching time. Folding here would change the signed bytes and differ between SDKs.
